items.prompt: Perfectly flat orthographic front view filling the entire frame edge to edge, no perspective, no background, even lighting, photographic: a strip of old off-white painted plaster wall beside a door frame, covered with a child's height marks drawn in pencil and ballpoint over the years: short horizontal lines, each with small handwritten Chinese notes and dates such as 爸爸 170, 我 1993.6.1, 弟弟 1990, 弟弟 1991, 弟弟 1992, faded and smudged, some marks in red pen, a few scuffs and fingerprints, realistic texture.
